reviewer: editorial review against the QC rubric

reasons.hook: Unchanged and still the second strongest in the batch.
reasons.retention: Unchanged. The 2003 line gives the middle a concrete anchor it did not have before.
reasons.originality: Resolved. The observation mechanic is gone and the script now runs on its own concept's twist - continuous real time - which no other script in the batch uses. The collision with 004 no longer exists.
reasons.twist: Slightly different in kind and equally strong: the reveal is now temporal rather than participatory. Twenty-two years of a room, played back one frame at a time, reframes the empty footage retroactively.
reasons.clarity: Unchanged. Every line is one fact.

notes: Approved. The rewrite also brought the script back in line with the concept it was commissioned from.
rewrite_note: Removed the 'it only moves while somebody is watching' mechanism, which duplicated 004 and was not in the source concept. Replaced it with PIX-002's own twist: the appended frames are continuous real time and the camera never stopped. Final two lines and two captions rewritten to match.
